title: The Dandridge Sisters on Lunceford theater tours
summary: The trio, with Etta Jones who later married Gerald Wilson, looked good and toured theaters with the band.

story.theme_name: Singers and the musicians who accompanied them

blocks.x: They were with us, and they did a couple of recordings with us, and I can't remember the year, but I know it was in the late '30's or the early '40's, and they -- we did some theater tours, and they looked good on the stage, you know, and Dorothy and her sister Vivian, and the with them other girl was not a sister. Her name was Etta Jones. And she later married Gerald Wilson. This was Gerald's first wife -- the arranger on the West Coast.
And they had a good -- they had a very good visual trio, you know. They were competent singers. I don't think

they were great singers, but they were competent, and they looked good; they were young, and they were nice looking girls, and they dressed well, and they looked nice. And they made quite a few tours with us, theater tours they did mostly, and we backed several big stars when I was with that band.
